visual_argument: The tissue's own materials show what SPACER found: ember T cells gather against cells next door and stop at the foot of a glossy mucin coat, and every figure the release gives is a count or a length on the same dark bench.
build_risk: The mucin wall at macro has to read as a soft wet barrier and not as icing, a bone ring or a crater, with T cells banked on its outer slope and its cast falling over the tumor cells; txbench has no transparency, so the coat reads only by its specular crest, its height and its cast.
distinct_from_recent: No. 52 was a staged nightSodium world around a kit robotaxi at an airport curb; no. 51 a lastLight courthouse and deposition room around a kit transcript; no. 50 a floodlit low water crossing around a sensor node. All three were txthree spatial scenes with one kit hero.
